meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数据或地图变成动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想做会动的标题、图表或地图,又不想学专业软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn headlines, data, or maps into short animated videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to bring titles, charts, or maps to life without learning pro software.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按固定流程制作 10 秒以内的动态图形:动效字幕、数字滚动、图表、logo 出场、地图动画、网页/推文动效等,输出 MP4 或透明背景视频,无旁白。流程自动推进,渲染前会先征求你的意见。
howto.when: 当你要做 10 秒内、无旁白的短动态图形(如动效字幕、数据图表、logo 出场等)时触发;更长、带解说或多个场景的内容会转给 /general-video。

say.text: 做一个 5 秒的动效字幕,内容是一句引言
say.note: 会按 kinetic-type 类别规划并制作

say.text: 把这份数据做成柱状图动画
say.note: 走 charts 类别,先生成图表演示

say.text: 给这个 logo 做 3 秒出场动效

howto.what_en: Claude creates short design-led motion graphics (~10s, no narration): kinetic typography, stat count-ups, charts, logo reveals, map animations, animated webpages/tweets, etc. Output is MP4 or transparent overlay. Workflow is autonomous; render requires explicit approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a short, unnarrated motion graphic (under ~10s) like kinetic type, charts, logo sting, etc. Longer/narrated/multi-scene content routes to /general-video.

say_en.text: Make a 5-second kinetic-type animation of this quote.
Animate this data as a bar chart.
Create a 3-second logo reveal for this logo.
